releaseNotes.summary: v0.9.4-beta offers more advanced logs filtering & navigation as well as URL query params. and also fixes some bugs.
changes: fixed the sidebar active page not receiving the active class
fixed the download button displaying plain text instead of downloading
fixed the bot showing offline on the sidebar (by adding the state property default)
made page state load dynamically/automatically when the page is initialised
registered `/webhook` route to `api-routes.js` (yes still that script is just documentaton for now..)
LOGS: Added First Line, Prev 100, Next 100 and Latest buttons
LOGS: Newly added logs are now highlighted
CMDS: Added /sz-release utility command to check for the latest release notes
CMDS: token now defaults to 32 if the 2nd argument is incorrect instead of throwing an error
added `release-history.json` so /sz-release 2nd arg can pull the release history
RAG: Added an emitActivity event thatll tell what actions the bot is doing (e.g. fetching, generating, etc.)
RAG: Added a withAi flag to `askQuestion` so i can debug and see some of the context is being sent to the AI model
RAG: added 2 new functions `resolveFileReference` and `extractPathReferences` to detect path-based dependencies inside code

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run lint && concurrently --names "BOT,SERVER" "npm run bot" "node server/server.js"
scripts.build:preview: vite build --open --config server/client/vite.config.mjs && vite preview --config server/client/vite.config.mjs
